GXO is a larger reference anchor for outsourced warehouse-scale reverse logistics. ThredUp and Envela are narrower recommerce infrastructure candidates: ThredUp is apparel resale infrastructure with RaaS/brand-client exposure, while Envela is a speculative electronics/luxury recommerce and ITAD/product-returns name.
